title: Relative module flatness is detected on a flat source cover
statement: Let $f:Y\to S$ and $h:X\to Y$ be morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme], and let $\mathcal G$ be a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_Y$-module [pqf-def-coherent]. Let $x\in X$ and put $y=h(x)$. If $h$ is flat at $x$ [def-weil-flat-morphism], then $\mathcal G$ is flat over $S$ at $y$ if and only if $h^*\mathcal G$ is flat over $S$ at $x$, where the two structure maps are $f$ and $fh$ respectively [def-pc-scheme-module-flat-over], [def-pc-module-pullback]; here $\mathcal G$ is flat over $S$ at $y$ if the stalk $\mathcal G_y$, an $\mathcal O_{S,f(y)}$-module through the stalk map of $f$, is flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map], and likewise $h^*\mathcal G$ is flat over $S$ at $x$ if $(h^*\mathcal G)_x$ is a flat $\mathcal O_{S,f(h(x))}$-module through the stalk map of $fh$. Consequently, for any jointly surjective family of flat morphisms $h_i:X_i\to Y$, the module $\mathcal G$ is flat over $S$ if and only if every $h_i^*\mathcal G$ is flat over $S$; jointly surjective means every point of $Y$ has a preimage in some $X_i$. No quasi-compactness, finite-presentation, or Noetherian hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Tag 02JZ, lemma-flat-permanence, pointwise equivalence; the family formulation follows pointwise from the displayed equivalence.

proof.text: Fix x∈X and write y=h(x), s=f(y), A=𝒪_{S,s}, B=𝒪_{Y,y}, C=𝒪_{X,x}, and N=𝒢_y. The stalk map B→C is local. Since h is flat at x, it is flat; a flat local homomorphism of local rings is faithfully flat by [lem-pc-local-flat-faithful-flat-reflects-surjective]. The stalk-of-pullback isomorphism [lem-weil-pbc-module-stalk-pullback] identifies (h^*𝒢)_x with N⊗_B C, and the induced A-actions agree because the structure map for fh is the composite of those for f and h.

source.place: Tag 02JZ proof: local rings, faithful flatness of the stalk map, and Sheaves Tag 0098

proof.text: Apply [lem-trf-flatness-faithfully-flat-extension] to A→B→C and N. It gives that 𝒢_y is flat over A if and only if N⊗_B C is flat over A. Via the stalk isomorphism and the compatible A-actions from Step 1, this is exactly the pointwise equivalence that 𝒢 is flat over S at y if and only if h^*𝒢 is flat over S at x.

source.place: Tag 02JZ proof, flatness criterion after the faithfully flat local stalk extension

proof.text: For a jointly surjective family of flat morphisms h_i:X_i→Y, each h_i^*𝒢 is quasi-coherent by [lem-weil-pbc-module-pullback-quasi-coherent], so its relative flatness over S through f h_i is defined. Assume 𝒢 is flat over S. By [lem-pc-relative-flat-module-stalk] every stalk 𝒢_y is flat over 𝒪_{S,f(y)}, i.e. 𝒢 is flat over S at every y. For x∈X_i, Step 2 (h_i is flat at x) gives that h_i^*𝒢 is flat over S at x; so all stalks of h_i^*𝒢 are flat over the base stalks, and [lem-pc-relative-flat-of-stalks], applied to the quasi-coherent module h_i^*𝒢 and the morphism f h_i, shows that h_i^*𝒢 is flat over S. Conversely, assume every h_i^*𝒢 is flat over S. By [lem-pc-relative-flat-module-stalk] applied to f h_i, every stalk (h_i^*𝒢)_x is flat over 𝒪_{S,f h_i(x)}. Given y∈Y, joint surjectivity supplies some i and x∈X_i with h_i(x)=y; Step 2 then gives that 𝒢 is flat over S at y. Since this holds for every y and 𝒢 is quasi-coherent, [lem-pc-relative-flat-of-stalks] shows that 𝒢 is flat over S.

lean.statement: theorem relative_flatness_source_cover {Y S : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ S) (G : Y.Modules) [G.IsQuasicoherent] : (∀ (X : Scheme.{u}) (h : X ⟶ Y) (x : X), (h.stalkMap x).hom.Flat → (Module.Flat (S.presheaf.stalk (f (h x))) ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars (f.stalkMap (h x)).hom).obj ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor Y.toRingedSpace (h x)).obj G)) ↔ Module.Flat (S.presheaf.stalk ((h ≫ f) x)) ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars ((h ≫ f).stalkMap x).hom).obj ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace x).obj ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback h).obj G))))) ∧ (∀ (I : Type v) (X : I → Scheme.{u}) (h : ∀ i : I, X i ⟶ Y), (∀ i : I, Flat (h i)) → (∀ y : Y, ∃ (i : I) (x : X i), h i x = y) → (G.IsFlatOver f ↔ ∀ i : I, ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (h i)).obj G).IsFlatOver (h i ≫ f)))
